body.en:
Question B-003-001-008.

Why the correct answer is right: The SWR meter is placed after the low-pass filter and before the tuner so reflected-power readings show the load being presented to the transmitter side of the matching network.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "The last stage of RF amplification": The low-pass filter belongs between the final RF stage and the meter, so the meter is not the first item after the amplifier or transceiver output.
- sourceIndex 2: "The antenna tuner": A meter after the tuner is on the antenna side of the matching network; it would not show the transmitter-side match that the tuner is adjusted to provide.
- sourceIndex 3: "The antenna switch": The switch is farther toward the selected antenna or dummy load, so a meter there would sample only that downstream path instead of the match before the tuner and switch.
